title: How to Build a SaaS App With AI (Without Writing Code)
summary: Build a SaaS app with AI in a single day — auth, database, and Stripe billing included. No developer required. Step-by-step guide for non-technical founders.
body_markdown: Yes — with a full-stack AI builder that provisions multi-tenant auth, database, and billing automatically. Blink generates a PostgreSQL database with row-level security, Stripe subscription integration, and hosted auth from a plain-language description. The result is a production SaaS with real billing and real data isolation, not a chatbot or a demo.
